prepare.limitation: Prepare uses direct local buffers, not TPipe, and does not itself invoke the shown reset. Default-mode modeling is supported by CANN default CTRL plus absence of an enable, but this is not proof of the captured runtime's incoming CTRL. HF32 persists until disabled within a control context.

theoretical_peaks.scope: Nominal body-throughput derivation, excluding startup, dependencies, contention and clock variation. No measurement fit or empirical multiplier.

reg_vector.scope: NpuArch3510 / Ascend 950, not A3 Memory API.

issue_topology.warning: Dual-capable is a concurrency capability; dependent instructions do not become zero-latency. Do not create independent resources for every opcode or assume both slots always occupied.

selected_lowering.qualifier: MERGING follows an additional CopyMerging path.

interleave_counting.basis: Single-issue table explicitly defines one instruction per cycle, and maps VINTLV/VDINTLV to these APIs. Exact CANN uses one paired-output builtin. The 2-register write limit accommodates both outputs.
interleave_counting.not_proven: Full dependency latency or final compiler DCE of the entire VF. No claim that an unused second output halves a paired instruction.

mask.modeling_boundary: Keep valid arithmetic elements and fixed instruction issue demand separate. A masked call still passes the same instruction form; this does not supply undocumented result latency.

ftz.nondefault: FTZ=false and explicit precision modes can expand Sqrt/Div into several register instructions; hardware 16 elements/cycle is not a rate for the entire software API.

generic_vector_rate_warning.interpretation: 27.0336 TFLOP/s can describe two FMAs/cycle counting multiply+add, not a universal 256 FP32 Add elements/AIV/cycle. Conversely 6.7584 T elements/s is not a universal maximum because independent dual issue exists.

mask_timing_followup.conclusion: The documents specify valid lanes, single-instruction throughput and dual-issue eligibility, but do not say whether sparse masks shorten hardware execution occupancy. The same vsqrt/vdiv builtin cannot prove either fixed four-cycle or active-lane-scaled one-cycle service. Keep masked service parameterized and separate from result latency.
mask_timing_followup.issue_capacity_interpretation: A dual-capable instruction consumes one issue slot; at most two eligible independent instructions can issue per cycle. This is not a claim of 0.5-cycle instruction latency. The two-data-register-write rule must not silently include predicate writes: the table does not establish whether MaskReg and RegTensor share a write port.

bf16_to_fp32.qualifier: ZEROING path only; MERGING adds CopyMerging. A layout selects positions, not another 128-element conversion.

fp32_to_bf16.source_builtin: one vcvt with rounding, saturation and layout

other_predicate_apis.qualifier: Do not transfer these predicate API cycle entries to PSET/PLT or ordinary vector Interleave/DeInterleave.

modes.api: StoreAlign<bf16, DIST_PACK_B32> with 64 active b32 source elements

ub_payload_followup.qualifier: Payload bytes follow the documented instruction semantics. They are not evidence of physical UB bank transaction granules or fractional port occupation. Keep instruction issue capacity, register writes and logical UB byte conservation separate. Do not charge 256B of UB payload merely because a destination/source register is 256B wide.

memory_rate_semantics.consumer_note: GetCoreMemBw forwards to GetLocalMemBw, whose public implementation retrieves only AICoreMemoryRates.ddr_rate for HBM. No core-type selection or normalization is in that path. Public implementation is not exact-image SHA matched.
memory_rate_semantics.recommendation: Keep 80/40 as platform nominal metadata or explicit configurable hypothesis, not a verified physical MTE2/owner service ceiling. Separate AIC and AIV topology is supported, but rates need a consumer/architecture contract establishing owner semantics.

limitations: This report validates source and nominal instruction contracts, not end-to-end model accuracy.
